user.title: Price sensor
user.description: Pair one all-inclusive dynamic price sensor with a currency. Every appliance added to this entry is costed against this price at the moment of consumption.

data_description.price_sensor: All-inclusive price per energy unit, for example EUR/kWh or EUR/MWh. The integration converts units but never adds fees, VAT, or margins — this sensor is the only price authority.
data_description.currency: Must match the price sensor's unit numerator exactly. The currency is immutable after creation: to change it, remove this entry and add it again (a mixed-currency cost series would corrupt statistics).

confirm_no_statistics.title: No hourly statistics for this price sensor
confirm_no_statistics.description: {price_sensor} does not declare state_class: measurement, so Home Assistant records no hourly mean statistics for it. Live costing works; the historical backfill will not. Submit to continue anyway.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure price sensor
reconfigure.description: Change the price sensor of this entry. The currency is immutable: to change it, remove this entry and add it again (a mixed-currency cost series would corrupt statistics).

data_description.price_sensor: All-inclusive price per energy unit, for example EUR/kWh or EUR/MWh. The integration converts units but never adds fees, VAT, or margins — this sensor is the only price authority.

error.price_sensor_unavailable: The selected price sensor is unavailable. Its current state is needed to validate the unit; try again when it has a value.
error.price_not_numeric: The price sensor's state {state} is not numeric.
error.price_unit_unsupported: The price sensor's unit {unit} is not supported. Expected a per-energy price such as EUR/kWh, EUR/MWh or EUR/Wh.
error.currency_mismatch: Price unit numerator {numerator} does not match currency {currency}. This integration never rescales prices (a subunit price like snt/kWh would be 100x off) — point it at a sensor in {currency}/kWh or {currency}/MWh.

abort.already_configured: A config entry for this price sensor already exists.

user.title: Add appliance
user.description: Name the appliance and pick its existing cumulative energy sensor. The appliance's cost sensor prices consumed energy at the price in force at the moment of consumption.

data_description.name: Display name for the appliance and its cost sensor.
data_description.energy_sensor: An existing cumulative energy sensor in Wh, kWh or MWh with state_class total or total_increasing. Only energy this sensor has already measured is costed.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure appliance
reconfigure.description: Rename the appliance or swap its energy sensor. Swapping keeps the accumulated cost and re-baselines from the new sensor's current reading.

data_description.name: Display name for the appliance and its cost sensor.
data_description.energy_sensor: An existing cumulative energy sensor in Wh, kWh or MWh with state_class total or total_increasing. Only energy this sensor has already measured is costed.

error.energy_sensor_unavailable: The selected energy sensor is unavailable. Its current state is needed to validate the unit; try again when it has a value.
error.energy_unit_unsupported: The energy sensor's unit {unit} is not supported. Expected Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.energy_not_cumulative: Only cumulative energy sensors (state_class total or total_increasing) can be costed; a power or per-period sensor would corrupt the figures.
error.energy_not_numeric: The energy sensor's state {state} is not numeric.
error.duplicate_energy_sensor: {other_appliance} already uses this energy sensor in this entry.

abort.already_configured: An appliance for this energy sensor already exists in this entry.
